scientific_limitations: The claim treats exactly the seven-point root-neighbor set on each square finite torus, not larger hexagons or anisotropic weights. Independent mathematical validation and publication-priority certification have not been performed. The earliest exact-day, publicly posted source verified here is arXiv:math/0204086 (2002-04-08); the related Arestov–Berdysheva paper appeared in 2001 but an exact public-release day was not established.
title: Exact hexagonal Turán mass and divisibility-three optimizer rigidity on finite tori
